Class TribePopupController

java.lang.Object
view.TribePopupController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ViewController
public class TribePopupController extends Object implements ViewController
Popup that shows another player's full tribe. Characters are grouped by type (HUNTER, BUILDER, …) and each card carries a short caption with the key info (e.g. star count for shamans). Click any card to zoom it.

  • Method Details

    • closeIfOpen

      public static void closeIfOpen()
      Called by EventResolutionOverlay.

      When an event is resolved, if the tribe popup is open, it's automatically closed to avoid having two popups opened together.

    • show

      public static void show(javafx.stage.Window owner, PlayerDto target)
      Main method of the TribePopupController. Called when the user clicks the summary panel of another player. It loads the FXML and appends it to the board view.
      Parameters:
      owner - the window that called the tribePopupController
      target - Player of which the data appears.
